meta.title: Select all or specific line items for re-evaluation
gaps: Open the Request Re-Evaluation drawer and select all eligible line items, then send the request
On another event, select only specified line items and send the request
Verify exactly the selected line items show "Re-evaluation Requested" while unselected items do not
warnings: cannot test this case yet — no step can observe: Open the Request Re-Evaluation drawer and select all eligible line items, then send the request; On another event, select only specified line items and send the request; Verify exactly the selected line items show "Re-evaluation Requested" while unselected items do not

args.goal: With the Request Re-Evaluation drawer already open, select all eligible line items and send the request; then on another event select only the specified eligible line items and send the request, stopping on a screen that proves only the selected items are marked "Re-evaluation Requested"

steps.note: No catalog step can operate or assert the Request Re-Evaluation drawer and its line-item selection state.
Closest available assertion for the expected status marking, but it cannot verify the exact selected-item set.
